title: BIR Form No. 1701A — Annual Income Tax Return for Individuals Earning Income Purely from Business/Profession

period.label: Item 1 — Month of the short period

choice_rows.label: Item 1 — Month of the short period
Item 17 — If married, spouse has income?
If overpayment, mark one box only
options: To be issued a Tax Credit Certificate

atc.label: Item 7 — ATC (sets Item 19, the tax rate)

validation.how: Messages only in a 'Needs review' block after Part II totals (first 20); labels turn red; Queue for submission is disabled.

findings.now: Items 42 and 51 take one amount each and there is no '(add more...)' control, so a second other-income row cannot be entered.
findings.why: The model stores up to 100 add-more rows and folds Items 42 and 51 into OTHERS when two or more exist (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1701a.rs:182, 280-283), but the official add-more links (BIR-Form1701A.hta:1128, 1265) have no counterpart on this page.

options.name: Modal list like the official form
options.detail: Open a list from Item 42 and Item 51 with description, taxpayer and spouse columns and the OTHERS subtotal.

options.name: Inline repeating rows
options.detail: Show extra rows under Items 42 and 51 with an Add row button, capped at 100.

options.name: Block with a clear message
options.detail: Stop Queue for submission and name the item when more than one row is needed, as a stop-gap.

findings.now: The year box stays editable after creation, and Save draft under another year can overwrite the Draft already stored for that year.
findings.why: upsert_from_draft selects the stored draft by taxable_year and UPDATEs a matching Draft with this page's data (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:154-175).

options.name: Read-only year
options.detail: Show the year as fixed text once the draft exists and open other years from the library.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft when the year differs from the stored year and point to the existing draft.

options.name: Confirm before overwrite
options.detail: Ask before saving when a Draft already exists for the new year.

findings.now: The printed 1701A sheet shows the Item 11 email in capitals because its writer cell is a text join.
findings.why: The 1701 sheet leaves its email unjoined because the official capital() skips txtEmail, and frozen_html.rs:83 uppercases every joined value, so the 1701A print breaks the never-upper-cased rule.

options.name: Drop the join
options.detail: Remove the txtEmail join so the sheet prints the email as typed, matching the 1701 sheet.

options.name: Exempt the key in the renderer
options.detail: Skip uppercasing for txtEmail in frozen_html.rs while keeping other joins in capitals.

options.name: Accept caps and record it
options.detail: If the team decides printed sheets are all caps, record that email as an explicit exception.

findings.field: Item 1 — Month of the short period
findings.now: Twelve buttons labelled 01 to 12 appear when Item 3 is Yes, with no month names.
findings.why: Twelve options are a combobox case, and bare numbers are harder to read as months.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A dropdown of January to December that stores 1 to 12.

options.name: Select with month names
options.detail: A native dropdown with month names and the same numeric values.

options.name: Buttons with names
options.detail: Keep the buttons but label them with month names; not recommended for twelve options.

findings.field: Item 7 — ATC (sets Item 19, the tax rate)
findings.now: Four long-label ATC buttons sit together, and the two that do not match the Item 6 type are greyed out.
findings.why: ATC is a single pick, so the four official radio slots map to one combobox.

options.name: Filtered combobox
options.detail: Show only the two ATCs valid for the chosen Item 6 type.

options.name: Combobox with all four
options.detail: Show all four codes and mark the invalid ones as unavailable inside the list.

options.name: Vertical radio list
options.detail: A stacked single-choice list with the same labels.

findings.now: Labels turn red, but the message text appears only in the Needs review list after Part II, and Queue for submission stays disabled.
findings.why: The filer has to find the bottom block to learn why filing is blocked.

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its field, using the error keys the page already tracks.

options.name: Summary beside Queue
options.detail: Put the Needs review list next to Queue for submission with a jump link per item.

options.name: Jump to first error
options.detail: Add a button that scrolls to the first field with a message.

findings.now: Name and address are sent in capitals even when they were only loaded from the profile.
findings.why: Under the bir-caps-display-only decision, profile-loaded fields keep their mixed case in the upload.

options.name: Uppercase only typed values
options.detail: Capitalise values the filer typed, as the official blur does, and keep profile values as stored.

options.name: Caps in the renderer
options.detail: Keep stored casing in the field map and let the print layer uppercase on the sheet.

options.name: Check a real upload first
options.detail: Compare a profile-only upload against the official output before changing the map.

findings.now: Choosing Yes shows no notice, while the official form tells the filer the Month must change to match the last return period.
findings.why: The official processShortPeriod alert (BIR-Form1701A.hta:3372) has no desktop counterpart.

options.name: Inline note
options.detail: Show the official sentence verbatim under Item 3 when Yes is chosen.

options.name: Toast on change
options.detail: Show the same sentence as a notification when Yes is selected.

options.name: Record as a known gap
options.detail: Document the missing notice rather than add it.

findings.now: A bad Item 4 check digit shows 'You have entered an incorrect TIN' with no item suffix, and a bad month reuses the Item 1 year message.
findings.why: The official TIN check messages end with the item number (BIR-Form1701A.hta:5780) and the official form has no month alert at all.

options.name: Official Item 4 wording
options.detail: Show 'Please enter a valid TIN number on Item 4.' for a bad check digit, the text the official Item 4 checks use.

options.name: Add the item suffix
options.detail: Show 'You have entered an incorrect TIN on Item 4.' following the official pattern.

options.name: Own month message
options.detail: Give the month field its own message instead of the Item 1 year text.

findings.now: Nothing visible changes, but commit f6829947 adds a 79-line 1701A test inside the shared bir-print module.
findings.why: Outside the form's own files only one-line registrations are allowed.

options.name: Move the test
options.detail: Move the filled-document test into the form_1701a test module and keep only the registration in frozen_html.rs.

options.name: Keep only the registration
options.detail: Delete the test from frozen_html.rs and rely on the form's own sample-payload tests.

options.name: Record an exception
options.detail: Record the test as a documented exception to the one-line rule.
